set.acceptance: internal/daemon self-update tests with fake git and make cover off, main with a Rhiza checkout, and main with none (logged, nothing updated); the daemon-settings testscript shows autoUpdate=off by default; the setting accepts off, main, latest and release and rejects any other value; the latest and release channels are checked by auto-update-latest's and auto-update-release's acceptance.
set.statement: rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate takes off (the default), main, latest or release: with main the daemon finds the registered project that is Rhiza's own source checkout by its module path, fast-forwards it when origin/main moves and runs make update, as self-update does today; latest and release install the newest published build of their channel and restart the daemon on it (auto-update-latest, auto-update-release); off never updates.
